intents.DOCUMENT_QUESTION: Asks about the content of course documents or materials (not a summary).
intents.DOCUMENT_SUMMARY: Asks for a summary of one specific document, file, or material.
intents.COURSE_SUMMARY: Asks for a summary or overview of a whole course.
intents.ANNOUNCEMENTS: Asks about course announcements or news posted on Moodle.
intents.MOODLE_CHANGES: Asks what changed, is new, or was updated on Moodle.
intents.COURSE_FACTS: Asks which courses the student is enrolled in.
intents.ASSIGNMENT_FACTS: Asks about assignments, homework, or their deadlines from academic records.
intents.UNROUTED: Anything else: write requests, study tasks, calendar, greetings, mixed or unclear requests. Handled by the existing model loop.
